nodes.label: cmd/intake
nodes.role: The program: reads orders from standard input and submits each one.

nodes.label: internal/orders
nodes.role: Accepts orders, prices them and writes them to a Store in batches.

nodes.label: orders.jsonl
nodes.role: The file accepted orders are appended to, one JSON object per line.

nodes.label: main.go
nodes.role: Parses the flags, runs the intake and prints a summary.

nodes.label: main()
nodes.role: Reads the -out flag and calls run.

nodes.label: run()
nodes.role: Opens the store, makes the Handler and submits every order it reads.

nodes.label: logSummary()
nodes.role: Prints how many orders had each outcome.

nodes.label: handler.go
nodes.role: The Handler: routing, the batch, the pending-bytes budget and the flush loop.

nodes.label: limiter.go
nodes.role: The Limiter: orders per customer in windows of one minute.

nodes.label: store.go
nodes.role: The Store interface and the FileStore that appends to a file.

nodes.label: Submit()
nodes.role: The entry point for one order.

nodes.label: process()
nodes.role: Runs validateLines, price and stamp in that order.

nodes.label: enqueue()
nodes.role: Adds a processed order to the batch and flushes at maxBatch.

nodes.label: reserve()
nodes.role: Adds bytes to pendingBytes and applies the soft and the hard limit.

nodes.label: flushLoop()
nodes.role: On every tick moves the deferred orders to the batch and flushes it.

nodes.label: flushLocked()
nodes.role: Writes the whole batch to the Store and keeps it if the write fails.

nodes.label: Close()
nodes.role: Stops the flush loop and flushes one last time.

nodes.label: Allow()
nodes.role: Records one order for the customer and returns the verdict.

nodes.label: Forget()
nodes.role: Removes customers whose window ended.

nodes.label: OpenFileStore()
nodes.role: Opens the file for appending.

nodes.label: WriteBatch()
nodes.role: Encodes all orders, appends them with one write and syncs the file.
